defects.title: Invalid due date is saved and then breaks My Tasks, the API list and the Dashboard (HTTP 500)
defects.env: Python 3.13, Flask 3.0.3, Werkzeug 3.x, Linux; Flask test client; fresh SQLite DB
defects.steps: 1. POST a task with due_date '2026-02-30' (API) or '2026-13-45' (form) 2. Open My Tasks
defects.actual: Create returns 500 but the row is stored; every later list/dashboard request returns 500
defects.origin: No server-side date validation; compute_urgency raises ValueError

defects.title: Empty title accepted (web form with spaces, API PUT with "")
defects.env: Python 3.13, Flask 3.0.3, Werkzeug 3.x, Linux; Flask test client; fresh SQLite DB
defects.steps: 1. POST /tasks/new with title '   ' 2. PUT /api/tasks/<id> {"title":""}
defects.actual: Task saved with an empty title (blank row)
defects.origin: Only API POST checks the title; client 'required' is bypassable

defects.title: PUT with done: "false" (string) marks the task as done
defects.env: Python 3.13, Flask 3.0.3, Werkzeug 3.x, Linux; Flask test client; fresh SQLite DB
defects.steps: 1. PUT /api/tasks/<id> {"done":"false"}
defects.actual: done = true; completed_at set
defects.origin: bool('false') is True; no type check

defects.title: Task can be created with a category id that does not exist
defects.env: Python 3.13, Flask 3.0.3, Werkzeug 3.x, Linux; Flask test client; fresh SQLite DB
defects.steps: 1. POST /api/tasks {"title":"x","category_id":999}
defects.actual: 201; category shown as null

defects.title: Invalid pagination values accepted (page=-1, per_page=0); page numbering (starts at 0) not documented
defects.env: Python 3.13, Flask 3.0.3, Werkzeug 3.x, Linux; Flask test client; fresh SQLite DB
defects.steps: 1. GET /api/tasks?page=-1 2. GET /api/tasks?per_page=0
defects.actual: 200 with results / 200 with empty list

defects.title: No maximum length for task title (5,000 characters accepted)
defects.env: Python 3.13, Flask 3.0.3, Werkzeug 3.x, Linux; Flask test client; fresh SQLite DB
defects.steps: 1. POST /api/tasks with a 5,000-character title
defects.actual: 201 Created

defects.title: Secret key is hard-coded and the app runs in debug mode (session forgery, debugger exposed)
defects.env: Python 3.13, Flask 3.0.3, Werkzeug 3.x, Linux; Flask test client; fresh SQLite DB
defects.pre: Attacker has read the public source code
defects.steps: 1. Sign a cookie {'user_id': 2} with 'pytodo-pro-dev-secret' 2. GET /api/tasks 3. Cause any server error
defects.expected: Forged cookie rejected (401); generic error page
defects.actual: Attacker reads qa_user2's tasks; error shows Werkzeug Debugger with traceback

defects.title: No CSRF protection on state-changing forms
defects.env: Python 3.13, Flask 3.0.3, Werkzeug 3.x, Linux; Flask test client; fresh SQLite DB
defects.steps: 1. Send POST /tasks/<id>/delete with Origin http://evil.example and the victim's cookie
defects.expected: Request refused (403) without a valid token
defects.actual: Task deleted (302)

defects.title: /api/categories works without logging in
defects.env: Python 3.13, Flask 3.0.3, Werkzeug 3.x, Linux; Flask test client; fresh SQLite DB
defects.steps: 1. GET /api/categories
defects.expected: 401 (README: all endpoints except register/login need a session)
defects.actual: 200 with category list

defects.title: Non-JSON request body gets a misleading error
defects.env: Python 3.13, Flask 3.0.3, Werkzeug 3.x, Linux; Flask test client; fresh SQLite DB
defects.steps: 1. POST /api/tasks with body 'not json' (text/plain)
defects.actual: 400 'title is required'

defects.title: Wrong JSON data types crash the server (HTTP 500)
defects.env: Python 3.13, Flask 3.0.3, Werkzeug 3.x, Linux; Flask test client; fresh SQLite DB
defects.steps: 1. POST /api/register {"username":12345,...} 2. POST /api/tasks {"title":123}
defects.actual: 500 Internal Server Error ('int' has no attribute 'strip')

defects.title: No limit on failed login attempts (brute force possible)
defects.env: Python 3.13, Flask 3.0.3, Werkzeug 3.x, Linux; Flask test client; fresh SQLite DB
defects.steps: 1. Send 10 wrong passwords 2. Send the right password
defects.actual: All 10 give 401; 11th logs in normally

defects.title: Session cookie still works after logout
defects.env: Python 3.13, Flask 3.0.3, Werkzeug 3.x, Linux; Flask test client; fresh SQLite DB
defects.steps: 1. Copy the session cookie 2. Log out 3. Send a request with the copied cookie
defects.actual: 200; still logged in
defects.origin: Client-side Flask session; logout only clears the browser copy

defects.title: Form fields, filter dropdowns and the complete button have no accessible name
defects.env: Chrome 153 (headless) on Linux; app via 'python app.py' (debug on) at 127.0.0.1:5000
defects.steps: 1. Run Axe on Login, Register, New Task, My Tasks 2. Inspect ○/✓ button
defects.actual: 7 inputs + 3 selects unlabeled (Axe critical); button announced as 'white circle'
defects.origin: <label> has no for= and does not wrap the input

defects.title: Low colour contrast for grey text (#999 on white = 2.8:1)
defects.env: Chrome 153 (headless) on Linux; app via 'python app.py' (debug on) at 127.0.0.1:5000
defects.steps: 1. Search for 'zzzz' 2. Run Axe
defects.actual: Empty-state message and done-task titles 2.8:1

defects.title: Layout breaks on phone width: sideways scrolling, Urgency column hidden
defects.env: Chrome 153 (headless) on Linux; app via 'python app.py' (debug on) at 127.0.0.1:5000
defects.steps: 1. Open My Tasks on a phone-size window
defects.expected: Content fits; all columns readable (WCAG 1.4.10 reflow)
defects.actual: Horizontal scroll on 4 pages; Urgency cut off; top bar crowded

defects.title: No confirmation message after create, edit or delete
defects.env: Chrome 153 (headless) on Linux; app via 'python app.py' (debug on) at 127.0.0.1:5000
defects.steps: 1. Create a task 2. Edit it 3. Delete it
defects.actual: Page reloads with no message

defects.title: Register form clears both fields after a validation error
defects.env: Chrome 153 (headless) on Linux; app via 'python app.py' (debug on) at 127.0.0.1:5000
defects.steps: 1. Register with username 'ab'
defects.expected: Username kept so it can be corrected
defects.actual: Both fields empty

defects.title: Login slows above 1 s when 25+ users log in at the same moment
defects.env: Locust 2.x against dev server
defects.steps: 1. run_perf.sh at 25 and 50 users (all start together)
defects.actual: Login p95 1,200 ms (25 users), 2,500 ms (50 users); other endpoints < 15 ms
defects.origin: CPU-heavy password hashing on a single dev server; partly an environment limit

usability: Simple layout; one main list; clear '+ New Task' button; first task created in under a minute.
Password rule is shown on Register but the 8-character rule is enforced as 9 (DEF-002), confusing new users.
Category and status filters apply instantly when changed.
Search needs the Filter button while the dropdowns apply instantly: inconsistent behaviour.
No sorting by due date; the list is always newest first, so urgent tasks can be far down.
Same top bar and button styles on every page; easy to return to after a break.
Delete asks for confirmation; required fields are checked by the browser; errors are in plain words.
Register form clears the typed values after an error (DEF-025); no success message after actions (DEF-024).
